summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of SUVI INTERIOR editorial site. Backend: 13 pytest tests (health, project-types, enquiry create valid/invalid/email-optional, admin-key auth, list persistence) all passed against the public URL. Frontend: verified Home (all 10 sections, hidden testimonials/google-reviews), Header nav + scroll-solid state + active link, Services hover crossfade preview + anchor scroll on /services (all 6 anchors), Projects filters (7) + detail page (all blocks) + lightbox (keyboard/buttons/Escape/counter) + next-project + unknown-slug redirect, Gallery (strip, 8 filters, 30 items, lightbox), Contact (validation without API call, successful submit persisted to Mongo, ?type= prefill, tel/wa/directions/map), About (no founder block), Footer + privacy/terms + 404 + robots/sitemap 200, SEO titles/canonical/JSON-LD LocalBusiness with +919702039381, mobile menu + sticky bar + swipe lightbox, and zero horizontal overflow at 360/390/768/1280/1440 across 6 pages. No console errors and no broken images on any page tested.
critical_code_review_comments: Optional: /api/enquiries has no rate limiting or spam protection — public POST endpoint could be abused (honeypot/throttle recommended before production).
Lightbox prev/next buttons are hidden below the sm breakpoint (mobile relies on the implemented touch-swipe only); consider a visible affordance/hint on mobile.
Contact project-type uses a native <select>; acceptable but a styled Select would match the editorial design better.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed enquiries via API (3) and one via UI form (TEST_UI Visitor). Left in DB for verification; can be removed by main agent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (run: pytest tests/backend_test.py -p no:randomly). Frontend needs ~2.5-3s wait after navigation (session preloader ~1.4s + 0.5s page transition). Services home preview is a stacked crossfade — assert computed opacity of the imgs inside [data-testid=services-preview], not src changes. Project-type field is a native SELECT (use select_option). Test enquiries in DB are prefixed TEST_.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found; nothing to root cause.
